_comment: MM in-house mods shown on the Modding page, in this order. Fields: name, category (small label above the name), status (one of: live, testing, development, planned; drives the filter buttons and badge), description (one or two sentences), requires (small tags at the bottom), link + link_label (optional; e.g. a Steam Workshop page; leave out to hide). To remove a mod from the site, delete its whole { ... } block.

mods.name: MM Oil Wells
mods.description: Craftable pumpjack kits plus static wells players can rent or buy. Pump crude, turn a profit.

mods.name: MM Lifeline
mods.description: Take the Medic role and answer Calls for Help from downed or knocked-out players, with a Discord ping for every call.

mods.name: MM NV Zones
mods.description: Admin-defined zones where night vision stops working. Bring a flashlight.

mods.name: MM BlackBox
mods.description: Server-side logging of deaths and their real cause, vehicles, travel and interactions, with an easy viewer for admins.

mods.name: MM Trade Runs
mods.description: ArcheAge-style trade packs: craft them at a workbench, haul them overland, and earn more for longer and riskier runs.

mods.name: MM Quest System
mods.description: An MM-styled rework of JuggaloJ419's DZ_QuestSystem, with a step-by-step in-game quest wizard.

mods.name: MM Bar Tending
mods.description: Bartender NPCs selling drinks from an admin-configured menu. Special drinks with buffs are planned.

mods.name: MM Welcome Screen
mods.description: Welcome message, rules and changelog you acknowledge once, and can reopen any time.

mods.name: MM Vehicle Impound
mods.description: Vehicles left too long in safe zones or garage spots get impounded. Pay the fee or watch it go to auction. First offence is free.
